A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the "Mammo-Site™" device should be used only as a complement to whole breast irradiation.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of spherical applicators as sole devices for APBI is not recommended.
the dose distribution in the breast should be homogeneous, the skin and ribs should be spared, and the dose should not be too high.
it is possible to improve the eventual outcome of the NSABR 39/RTOC 0413 trial by combining spherical applicator and whole breast irradiations.
